REGIONAL REGULATION OF THE CITY OF SINGKAWANG
NUMBER 4 OF 2017
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AND WOMEN
I. GENERAL
The implementation of protection for children and women is carried out based on the principles of humanity, integration and justice. So that every person must receive their right to protection against a sense of security and freedom from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity which is contrary to what is aspired to in the Preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, namely the creation of a just and civilized humanity.

In Article 2 of Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection, the implementation of Child Protection is based on Pancasila and grounded in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia as well as the basic principles of the Convention on the Rights of the Child including:
a. non-discrimination;
b. the best interests of the child;
c. the right to life, survival, and development; and
d. respect for the views of the child.

In Article 3 of Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, the elimination of domestic violence is implemented based on the principles of:
a. respect for human rights;
b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination; and
d. protection of victims.

In Article 3 of Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection, Child Protection aims to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from JDIH Kota Singkawang violence and discrimination, for the realization of quality Indonesian children who are virtuous and prosperous.

In Article 4 of Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, the elimination of domestic violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of violence in the household;
b. protect victims of domestic violence;
c. take action against perpetrators of domestic violence; and
d. maintain the integrity of a harmonious and prosperous household.

To realize law enforcement and the fulfillment of the basic rights of children and women, the Government of the City of Singkawang is obliged to provide protection from acts of violence and discrimination as well as the fulfillment of civil rights and freedoms which are set forth in a policy at the regional level.

The establishment of the Regional Regulation concerning the Protection of Children and Women is an elaboration of higher legislation that regulates the rights of children and women. In the Regional Regulation concerning the Protection of Children and Women, the norms formulated are efforts to address the problems faced in the implementation of the protection of children and women in the City of Singkawang. The implementation of the protection of children and women is carried out to realize the fulfillment of the rights of children and women in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and to receive protection from violence, discrimination, exploitation, and neglect for the realization of human resource development in the City of Singkawang that is faithful, intelligent, quality, virtuous and prosperous.
